statement: let f := fun (p : ℕ) => if p.Prime ∧ 2 < p then 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2 else 1; let twinC := ∏' p : ℕ, f p; RiemannHypothesis → Filter.Tendsto (fun D : ℕ => ((Finset.Icc 1 D).filter (fun n => n%2=1)).sum (fun n => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)*Real.log n / Nat.totient n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (2*twinC))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 短长除数与奇偶 · TP-0034 · 识别奇除数硬截断的 2C₂ 常数
plain_statement.en: New route · Short and long divisors · TP-0034 · Identify the hard cutoff limit over odd divisors

brief.zh: 卷积两个 Möbius 矩；p=2 的缺失提供因子 2。需控制截断尾部。
brief.en: Convolve the two Möbius moments and bound the cutoff tail. The omitted prime 2 supplies a factor of two.
